items.title: MECH-321 policy_decomposition P-A (env axis), dose escalation: harshened env v2 -> low-V_s production + region-V_s distribution recording

items.title: competence_floor R4 819a: reconcile worst-seed non-vacuity gate with strict-majority router + recalibrate 1.0 floor/margin (MECH-457/INV-088 z_world instrument-validity)
items.note: SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-819. TEST-DESIGN FIX (measurement_test_design_defect adjudicated in failure_autopsy_batch-793a-817-819_2026-07-26.md target 3, user-confirmed 2026-07-26). The 819 run's non-vacuity GATE and routing PREDICATE disagreed on the same data: post_bc_install_took scored install on the WORST seed (trained 0.9 vs 1.0 on seed 43, a 0.1 near-miss; random 0.4) so BOTH arms went red and the run was vacated zworld_advantage_grid_nondiscriminative, while the router's strict-majority install_took (trained 2/3, random 0/3) read an asymmetric-install advantage (headline.advantage_confirmed=true). The z_world encoder DID train (819 world_encoder_max_abs_delta 0.277-0.333, 3/3 seeds; V3-EXQ-780 frozen-random-projection fault stays fixed). THREE FIXES, all measurement (substrate + science unchanged): (1) post_bc_install_took now scored on the STRICT-MAJORITY install FRACTION (>0.5), the IDENTICAL predicate the router uses, so gate==router by construction and a non-installing control (0.0) never vacates the trained arm (0.667 green) -- realising the precondition's own 'NON-vacating per-arm' docstring; per-seed install stays at the 1.0 substrate floor (the defect was worst-seed aggregation, not the floor value). (2) ADVANTAGE_ABS_FLOOR 1.0->0.3, rescaled to the 0.35-2.4 res/ep near-floor band (~2% of the 48.05 local_view / 57.2 oracle ceiling; 819's 1.0 margin demanded a near-doubling and dominated the 0.15 relative bar). (3) seeds 3->6 (42..47), matching the 793a repower, for a firmer 4/6 strict-majority (with fix 1 a single seed no longer vacates under any rule). RE-DERIVE BRAKE DOES NOT FIRE: under R3 only genuine substrate_ceiling autopsies count and MECH-457/INV-088 have ZERO (whole campaign is competence_implementation_gap/measurement_test_design_defect); a test-design fix of an already-run leg is not a same-question ceiling re-pose. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = reconciled trained-vs-random z_world competence at strict-majority over 6 seeds; 819 vacated the run and recorded no such scored readout -> must run. DIAGNOSTIC (claim_ids MECH-457+INV-088 excluded from scoring; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING; route to /failure-autopsy). Resolves the pre-registered competence_floor R4 frozen-ledger leg H-zworld-trained-instrument (alive, awaiting a scored run). Reference build 128/3x/detached (NOT 769-falsified 256/5x). CONTROL arm (zworld_random_proj) mints reuse-eligible (include_driver_script_in_hash=False, shared lineage slice). Smoke PASS (dry-run full pipeline: encoder trains on trained arm, guard fires non-gating on control, eff_margin=0.3 live); validate_experiments/validate_recording --strict OK.

items.title: Q-081 cross-stream shared organisation: ON vs landmark-removal (RV(z_world, operating_mode))
items.note: First real Q-081 experiment. Uses the three landed preconditions (stream_recorder, q081_landmark_removal, q081_surrogate). GOV-REUSE-1: no existing manifest carries a per-step multi-stream trace (confirmed by the 2026-07-22 telemetry audit), so nothing was reanalyzable; this is a fresh run. Primary DV is the RV coefficient (Robert & Escoufier 1976) between the full z_world and operating_mode vectors (NOT the 1-D-reduced cross_stream_xcorr, per that function's own docstring caveat), on ON vs landmark-removed (iei_permute, the pre-registered PRIMARY mode) arms. Substrate finding surfaced during authoring, not routed around: e3_commitment is declared FRESH_CLOCK in stream_recorder.py but at least one field (running_variance) is actually updated every env tick via update_residue -> e3.post_action_update, so classify_hold_mode reports it HOLD_UNSTRUCTURED on a real rollout and block_permute_stream correctly refuses to build a surrogate for it -- operating_mode (identity-freshness, measured HOLD_CARRY, period 10.0) was substituted instead. Smoke-tested at full episode length (200 steps/ep) with a scaled-down episode/seed count; validate_experiments.py --strict clean.

items.title: INV-091: cross-stream similarity BAND falsifier (landmark-removal + forced-lockstep ablations on a shared trained substrate)
items.note: First experimental test of INV-091 (cross-stream similarity BAND; prior evidence lit-only, exp_conf=0.0, evidence_quadrant=plausible_unproven). Targeted probe: 2 of the claim's 7 named ablations (remove commitment landmarks / force lockstep), chosen to move cross-stream similarity in OPPOSITE directions from a shared intact baseline. All 3 arms (intact/decouple/lockstep) share ONE warmed-up agent per seed (E1/E2 world-forward + E3 harm-eval head via _lib.goal_pipeline_tier1.warmup_train); manipulations apply only at eval/recording time -- decouple via the already-built q081_landmark_removal yoked-permutation scrambler (mode=iei_permute, donor trains banked from the intact arm's own eval episodes), lockstep by mutating agent.clock rates between eval passes. Reuses the Q-081 infra landed 2026-07-22..2026-07-25 (stream_recorder, trace_store, q081_surrogate, q081_landmark_removal, q081_profile, dose_saturation) rather than rebuilding it. DV: cross_stream_similarity (mean |xcorr| over 4 cross-subsystem/cross-rate pairs: z_world-z_self, z_world-operating_mode, e1_hidden-e3_commitment, z_world-z_goal) vs a composite = min(z_task_reward, z_anti_collapse) [z_anti_collapse = 1-mean|cos(z_self, z_world)|], z-scored pooled across all 9 (arm x seed) cells -- a CONJUNCTIVE composite per the claim's own 'not merely satisfy each on a separate axis' wording. C1 (non-degeneracy, INV-091's own guard): similarity moves decouple<intact<lockstep by >= 0.02 each gap. C2 (falsifier): intact's composite exceeds BOTH extremes by >= 0.15 pooled-SD units (the non-monotonic band shape); a monotonic composite trend instead records which direction under interpretation.monotonic_direction. Q-081's own 'validate the null before using it' requirement is run once per manifest (screen_statistic confirms the real statistic is admissible while artefactual_rate_statistic is ruled_out) plus a per-cell evaluate_against_null surrogate p-value (constrained-realisation block-permutation null, 199 surrogates). GOV-REUSE-1: reanalysis_query.py --claim INV-091 and --claim Q-081 both scanned 0 manifests after the claim filter -- not recoverable, first run. Re-derive brake: 0 prior autopsies tag INV-091. Partial falsifier coverage only (2/7 named ablations); event broadcasts / mode conditioning / residue feedback / randomised rates / harm-stream collapse remain untested by this run -- noted in the manifest's interpretation.note so a PASS is not over-read as exhausting the claim. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2 seeds-equiv/2 eval eps/20 steps): correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue via C1 + independently via dose_saturation (toy-scale anti_collapse/composite/task_reward tied across arms, exactly the saturation guard working). validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings. validate_recording.py --strict on the dry-run manifest: OK (always-core complete).
